accent_color_desc: Colors of switches, dropdowns and sliders (the AI ball keeps its own colors)
ai_api_base_invalid: The base URL must start with http:// or https:// and include a host name
ai_api_base_tip: OpenAI-compatible base URL, usually ending in /v1. Filled automatically from the provider; edit freely (a local model can use http://127.0.0.1:port/v1).
ai_chat_not_saved: The conversation could not be saved to disk
ai_context_tip: How much chat history to send with each question. The full history is always saved on disk; longer context is more coherent but costs more tokens
ai_delete_confirm: This can't be undone. Delete this conversation?
ai_error_no_key: No API Key configured. Please fill it in at Settings → API Key
ai_error_no_model: No model name configured. Please fill it in at Settings → API Key (e.g. deepseek-v4.1-flash)
ai_history_empty_tip: Once you chat with GCP-AI, the records show up here.
ai_history_load_failed: This conversation file can't be read; it may be corrupted
ai_input_placeholder: Describe an app or site you want… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)
ai_mention_hint: Type @ to pick an entry from the library
ai_no_key_reply: No API Key configured yet — please fill in 请填写<API Key> and chat away.
ai_provider_hint_claude: Get an API key at console.anthropic.com
ai_provider_hint_custom: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: local Ollama / vLLM / one-api, etc. Enter the full URL
ai_provider_hint_deepseek: Get an API key at platform.deepseek.com
ai_provider_hint_grok: Get an API key at console.x.ai
ai_provider_hint_kimi: Get an API key at platform.kimi.com
ai_provider_hint_openai: Get an API key at platform.openai.com
ai_provider_hint_qwen: Get an API key in the Alibaba Cloud Bailian console (free quota available)
ai_provider_hint_siliconflow: Aggregator with many models; check the console model list for exact ids
ai_provider_tip: Pick a provider and the model name and base URL below are filled in automatically. Both boxes are editable — type any model id or your own endpoint.
ai_reply_language_tip: Force the language GCP-AI replies in (including its reasoning). Defaults to matching your latest message
ai_reply_mode_tip: Controls answer length and detail. Concise: max 4 lines, conclusion only. Standard: within 6 lines, a pick plus one alternative. Professional: about 10 lines with key differences. No mode outputs code.
ai_resource_not_found: No entry {code} in the library — it may have been removed.
ai_sidebar_mode: Use the sidebar AI page instead
ai_sidebar_mode_tip: Turns AI from the floating ball into a full page in the sidebar (right below GCP Workshop). The ball disappears while this is on.
ai_polish_empty: The input box is empty — write something to polish first
ai_polish_enable_tip: When on, a small "Enable polish" button appears at the right of the GCP-AI input (left of Send). Click it to polish your draft; turn it off to hide the button. Polishing only rewords text — it never sends or touches chat history.
ai_polish_tip: Polish the text in the input box (rewording only; it does not send or save)
ai_polish_undone: Restored the original text before polishing
ai_undo_polish_tip: Undo the polish and restore the original wording
ai_stream_enable_tip: When on, GCP-AI answers are typed out little by little (streaming); after sending you first see “AI is reading your question...”, which disappears as soon as the output starts. When off the answer arrives in one block. If the server does not support streaming it automatically falls back to one block
ai_stream_lost: Live output for this answer was interrupted; showing what was saved
ai_key_for_provider_missing: No API key saved for this provider yet — fill it in and click Save
ai_key_for_provider_saved: API key saved for this provider
ai_think_on_tip: Thinking is on: the answer shows the model's reasoning first
ai_think_off_tip: Turn on to show a collapsible reasoning block
ai_think_on_toast: Thinking enabled: answers will show the reasoning first
ai_model_tip: Switch model (only providers with an API key are listed)
ai_model_no_key_body: No provider has an API key yet.
ai_welcome: Just say what you need — e.g. "a tool to transfer files over my LAN" — and I'll find it in the library.
api_key_tip: Enter the API key for third-party services. It will be stored in the local config file
api_unsaved_body:
Provider / model / API base / API key have unsaved changes.
Choose Save and continue, Discard changes, or Stay here.
auto_search_tip: When enabled, search as you type; when disabled, press Enter or click search button
card_mention_tip: Mention to GCP-AI: bring this entry into the AI input box
close_mode_tip: Choose the behavior when clicking the close button: exit completely or hide to tray
cloud_boot_failed: Cloud resource library failed to load (retried {n} times, 60s each). Falling back to the local library: {err}
cloud_error_BAD_RESPONSE: The cloud returned an unexpected response — the local library is kept
cloud_error_INVALID_JSON: The cloud library is malformed — rejected, the local library is kept
cloud_error_NETWORK: Failed to reach the cloud (check your network or switch the mirror)
cloud_error_NOT_CONFIGURED: Cloud resource repository is not configured yet
cloud_error_NO_ASSET: The latest release has no resource library file (the author may not have uploaded it yet)
cloud_error_NO_RELEASE: The repository has no available release yet
cloud_error_RATE_LIMITED: Too many cloud requests — please try again later
cloud_lib_syncing: Cloud library: checking the latest version…
ctrl_open_tip: Ctrl+click: open quietly without switching away
debug_info_tip: When enabled, displays component IDs, object names, memory usage, render layers and other debug info
dev_key_empty: Please enter the developer identity token
dev_mode_tip: Enter the correct key to unlock more hidden content, debugging features, and additional permissions
card_releases_tip: View this repository's Releases and download directly
releases_hint: Click any file to start downloading; .exe/.msi/.dmg/.AppImage/.deb/.rpm/.zip are usually installers.
releases_empty: This repository has no downloadable release
releases_no_repo: This resource has no GitHub repository URL
releases_missing_api: The desktop download API is not available yet (downloader.releases)
download_empty: No download tasks yet. Open a resource's Releases and click a file.
download_speed_limit_tip: Cap the download speed so it does not fill your bandwidth
gcp_key_tip: Enter a valid GCP License Key to unlock hidden features
github_mirror_footer: Mirrors are run by third parties as a public service: this app only redirects — it never proxies or modifies files, and cannot promise the mirrors stay available. Check the official hash before installing.
github_mirror_hint: The mirrors below simply forward the link above; they are usually much faster in mainland China. If one does not work, try the next one — or use "Download" above to go through GitHub directly.
hotkey_ai_tip: Pressing this shortcut from any program opens the GCP-AI panel
hotkey_browser_tip: Starts the local interface server and opens it in your default browser while hiding the desktop window to the tray. Features are identical to the desktop app; the browser keeps talking to this program, so do not quit it (restore the window from the tray icon).
hotkey_enable_tip: Once enabled, the shortcut is exclusive to this app and other programs will not receive it
hotkey_err_need_modifier: A hotkey needs at least one modifier (Ctrl / Alt / Shift / Win) or an F1–F24 key
hotkey_err_no_main_key: Missing the main key (for example Q or F9)
hotkey_err_occupied: The shortcut {sequence} is already taken by another program — please pick another one
hotkey_err_one_main_key: Only one main key is allowed — got both {first} and {second}
hotkey_err_register_failed: Could not register the shortcut {sequence} (error code {code})
hotkey_err_system_key: {key} cannot be the main key of a shortcut (the system reserves it) — please pick another combination
hotkey_err_unsupported: Global hotkeys are not supported on this system
hotkey_hint: Click the box on the right and press the key combination you want. Esc cancels, Backspace clears.
hotkey_placeholder: Click here, then press the shortcut
hotkey_search_tip: Pressing this shortcut from any program brings ToolsGCP to the front and focuses the search box
language_desc: Takes effect after restarting the app
license_tip: Enter a valid key to unlock all features
limit_token_tip: Cap the number of tokens in a single reply
link_tip_open: Click to open in the browser; Ctrl+Click to open inside the app
minimize_to_tray_tip: When enabled, the app will hide to tray on startup without showing the main window
model_name_placeholder: Enter model name (e.g. gpt-4, claude-3, etc.)
model_name_required: Please choose or type a model name first
model_name_saved: Model name and API Key saved
model_name_tip: Enter the AI model name to use, saved together with the API Key
model_select_tip: Pick one of the models this provider supports (the list follows the provider; only supported models are listed), or type any custom model name
nav_hover_expand_tip: When on, moving the pointer onto the sidebar expands it. When off, only the hamburger button at the top-left expands it. Off by default.
nav_indicator_bounce_off_tip: Off by default: the blue indicator stretches and springs slightly when it catches up. Turn this on to remove the overshoot — it stops exactly where it lands (stretching stays).
privacy_agreed_toast: Your consent has been recorded. Thank you!
resource_source_tip:
Cloud: uses the newest library published in the author's GitHub Releases — the app picks the latest version automatically and loads ToolsGCP-Resources.json from it.
Local: uses the ToolsGCP-Resources.json on your own disk, handy for edited libraries or offline debugging.
This only decides where the library is read from; it does not affect the search/download sources below.
scroll_inertia_tip: After you stop scrolling, the page keeps gliding for a short distance (about 60–140px), like a real inertial scroll. Off by default.
scroll_inertia_strength_tip: Higher values glide farther after you stop scrolling. Default 35%, range 1%–100%.
search_card_size_tip: Change the size of search page cards. Takes effect immediately.
search_view_mode_tip: Tile: 4 large cards per row; Grid: 6 small cards, favourite only
show_github_button_tip: Show the GitHub button on search cards (on by default)
show_view_switch: Show the view switch on the search page
show_view_switch_tip: Hides the tile/grid switch on the search toolbar and lets sorting move right. The "Search page view" option below still works.
splash_screen_duration_tip: The splash duration slider exists because Python needs time to load resources
splash_screen_tip: Show splash screen on startup when enabled
nav_indicator_bounce_tip: When on, the blue indicator slides with a slight overshoot bounce (stretch kept); off by default = clean stop, no bounce
storage_location_desc: Config, chat history and logs are stored here
storage_location_tip: Resource files (library, icons, language packs) are not here; they ship with the app
storage_restart_body: The storage location has been migrated. Restart the program for it to take effect.
storage_restart_hint: Restart the app for it to fully take effect
storage_same_path: That folder is already the current location
theme_effect_tip: Mica: barely blurred with a subtle noise. Glass: heavy blur, high transparency. Acrylic: medium blur with a bright highlight edge. Only the title bar, sidebar and popups are affected; content stays crisp.
theme_mode_desc: Follow the Windows light / dark setting
toast_position_tip: Where the small pop-up hints (success / failure) appear on screen.
tray_disabled: Minimize to tray on startup disabled
tray_enabled: Minimize to tray on startup enabled
ui_animation_tip: On: all animations. Reduced motion: all UI transitions are shortened for snappier feedback. No animation: everything except the startup splash is disabled (the sidebar indicator jumps instantly).
ui_font_desc: Font used across the whole app; takes effect immediately. Pick "Follow system" to reset.
update_channel_tip: Which releases "Check for Updates" accepts: Stable + Beta (default), Stable only, or Beta only.
update_dir_fallback: The program folder is not writable; the update was saved to your Downloads folder
update_download_auto_restart: Verified. Replacing the program and restarting now… (click Later to postpone)
update_download_cannot_replace: Verified, but this environment cannot replace the program automatically. Click "Why?" to see which case applies.
update_download_done_tip: Verified. The file is saved at the location below.
update_download_ready_replace: Verified. Click "Restart & update now" to replace the program and launch the new version.
update_err_bad_response: Unexpected response from the server, please try again later
update_err_checksum: Checksum mismatch — the download may be incomplete, please retry
update_err_disk: Failed to write the file — check disk space and permissions
update_err_network: Network error, please check your connection and retry
update_err_no_asset: ToolsGCP.exe was not found in this release
update_err_no_channel_release: No release in the selected channel — try another channel
update_err_no_release: The author hasn't published any releases yet
update_err_not_exe: The downloaded file is not an executable
update_err_rate_limit: GitHub API rate limit reached, please try again later
update_err_timeout: Checking for updates timed out, please try again later
update_err_too_small: The downloaded file is incomplete (unexpected size)
update_is_latest: You are on the latest version
update_replace_failed_intro: The new version has been downloaded, but the program could not replace itself. The usual reasons are listed below:
update_replace_manual_tip:
New version file: {path}
Click "Open folder" and rename it to ToolsGCP.exe to replace the old file manually.
update_replace_other: Other reasons that can also break the replacement:
update_replace_reason_no_exe: ToolsGCP.exe cannot be found in the current folder (deleted, or this is still a development folder)
update_replace_reason_not_windows: This system is not Windows (the auto-replace script only works on Windows)
update_replace_reason_not_writable: The program folder is not writable (installed under Program Files, on a read-only or network drive)
update_replace_reason_renamed: The program file name contains non-ASCII characters — the replace helper only handles plain-ASCII names (rename it to ASCII and it can update itself)
update_replace_reason_script: The helper script cannot be written to the temp folder (temp folder not writable, or blocked by security software)
update_replace_reason_source_run: Running from source code (development state) — there is no ToolsGCP.exe in the folder to replace
update_replace_reason_stage: Copying the new version into the program folder failed (no disk space, not enough permission, or blocked by security software)
update_warn_not_exe: May not be a program file
set_cloud_lib_failed: Failed to fetch the cloud library: {error}
set_cloud_lib_failed_hint: Try another mirror in Settings → Download → Search source, then retry.
set_download_threads_tip: Splits a file into chunks downloaded in parallel; more threads means a higher speed ceiling (default 100). Falls back to single-threaded when the server does not support range requests.
set_download_retry_tip: How many times a failed download is retried, 30 seconds apart. Once the connection succeeds, the retry count resets to the default of 5.
set_download_save_dir_tip: Where downloaded files are saved. Leave empty to use the system Downloads folder (the extra ToolsGCP subfolder is no longer created).
set_download_dir_failed: Could not choose the download folder: {err}
update_err_no_exe: There is no build with ToolsGCP.exe in the selected update channel
ai_no_key_chat: No {missing} configured yet. fill in <API Key> to start chatting.\n(This message was saved to history — you can continue after setting it up.)
ai_no_key_polish: No {missing} configured — fill in <API Key> before polishing
ai_no_key_test: No {missing} configured — fill in <API Key> before testing
ai_key_invalid: API key is invalid or not permitted (expired, revoked, or it belongs to a different provider). fill in <API Key> and try again{suffix}
ai_err_key_invalid: API key is invalid or not permitted (expired, revoked, or it belongs to a different provider). fill in <API Key> and try again
ai_err_auth: API key is invalid or not permitted (expired, revoked, or it belongs to a different provider). fill in <API Key> and try again
ai_err_rate: Rate limited or quota exhausted — try again shortly
ai_err_bad_request: Request rejected — usually a wrong model name or parameter
ai_err_bad_json: The model returned only reasoning and no answer — turn Thinking off and retry
ai_err_config: Endpoint not found (404) — check Settings → API base URL
ai_polish_btn_tip: Polish the text in the input box: rewording only — nothing is sent and nothing enters chat history
ai_polish_need_key_tip: No API Key yet — configure one for a provider in Settings first
ai_prof_label_ph: Display label only — does not affect calls
ai_prof_label_hint: Just a label shown in chat; the model actually called is the first in the supported list
ai_prof_add_model_ph: Model name not in list, press Enter to add
ai_prof_need_model: Select at least one supported model
ai_prof_delete_confirm:
Delete the configuration for "{name}"?
Its API Key will be removed too.
ai_prof_bar_tip: Used top-down by priority; deleting one falls through to the next
ai_prof_empty: No provider configured yet. Use "Add provider" at the top right.
ai_prof_base_hint: OpenAI-compatible endpoint, usually ends with /v1; local models can use http://127.0.0.1:port/v1
ai_prof_models_manual: This provider has no built-in list — type model names below
ai_prof_models_pick_first: Pick a provider first — its models will be listed here
